layers.text: Every September, Arctic sea ice shrinks to its yearly low.
Each ring: one year's minimum, drawn as an equal-area cap around the North Pole.
Since 1979, the September ice has shrunk by a third.
Source: NSIDC Sea Ice Index, Version 4 (G02135) · Northern Hemisphere September mean extent, 1979–2026
